offline.scope: Same recorded ego inputs, no Nav2 reaction; not a closed-loop comparison. Baseline reproduction error is measured. Native host-time goal expiry limits long offline counterfactuals.

criteria: One fresh attempt per cell, preserve any failure; no tuning during capture series.
All captures must pass native GPU/raw sensor/TF/costmap integrity audit.
Robot screen: actual goal reached (world XY<=.2m yaw<=.25rad), positive swept human/static clearance and zero progress failures/recoveries; compare both original v6 captures.

Human offline screen: aggregate yaw total variation at least 50% below legacy over same 12s robot input. Report path lengths, yaw/metre, heading versus velocity, group spread and safety projection diagnostics; reduction alone is not social realism acceptance.

Human closed-loop: audit plus actual goal and positive swept clearances; compare to matched legacy v7. Report rotations over first 12s and full episode, group cohesion/lifecycle and progress failures.

No default promotion or dataset/WM acceptance. MPPI RNG is not pinned, seed45 is not multi-seed robustness. Group motion adapter changes radius and velocity initialization together; no individual-parameter causal claim.
unchanged: Native robot/camera/TF, map/start/goal, Nav2 tolerances/progress checker and speed limits, six initial humans, native human goals/lifecycle/RNG/turn limits, per-person ORCA and swept collision projection; human virtual robot radius .25 retained.
